attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Removing 'type=module' from admin/theme scripts changes script execution semantics (module vs classic scope, deferred execution, strict mode) which could break TheAdmin.js/theme-manager.js if they rely on ES module features, and this affects the default admin theme used by virtually all tenants."}

reason: Removing 'type=module' from admin/theme scripts changes script execution semantics (module vs classic scope, deferred execution, strict mode) which could break TheAdmin.js/theme-manager.js if they rely on ES module features, and this affects the default admin theme used by virtually all tenants.
